title: Fascinating! I have dreams of alleyways, hallways, mall-like places too!
content: I have a lot of dreams where roadsmor.paths turn into alleyways, that narrow into hallways, that lead to doors. Sometimes there are funny results, like I'm riding a bike on a suburban, tree-lined sidewalk, then I'm in a narrow, dingy alley between some dirty brick industrial buildings, and then I'm riding my bike down a very nice, carpeted hallway, and then I come to a fancy door. So I open it because there's nowhere else to go, and it turns out to just be some family's luxury apartment, and they have no idea what I'm doing in their home.🤣
